limitations: Before images compare the pinned baseline using the same synthetic fixtures; baseline defects are displayed, not treated as passing layout checks.
Geometry assertions apply to the after tree. Native browser zoom is established by the extension getZoom=2 and a 720-CSS-pixel viewport.
Custom palette changes exist only in the disposable browser. No owner instance, live mail, real automation, real credential or production screenshot is used.
Small semantic previews and fixed editor collections intentionally do not invent CRUD paging. Responsive tables use labelled cells where the column header is hidden.
